title: Monotonicity of the critical point in two-dimensional oriented percolation with enhancement
journal_ref: Brazilian Journal of Probability and Statistics 39 (2025), no. 2, 204-209
abstract: In this note, we investigate Bernoulli oriented bond percolation with parameter $p$ on $\mathbb{Z}^2$. In addition to the standard edges, which are open with probability $p$, we introduce diagonal edges each open with probability $\varepsilon$. Every edge is open or closed independently of all other edges. We prove that the critical parameter for this model is strictly decreasing in $\varepsilon$.
